answer: Restitution bonding resists sybils: each identity locks collateral that, when cheating is proven, is not merely burned but paid out to the agents it harmed. The forfeited stake becomes an anchor of compensation, so fraud funds its own victims and the network is made whole. One honest account never risks its bond; a swarm must forge and fund a separate deposit per clone, and each caught fake bankrolls restitution instead of a dead burn. The atlas of fakes pays to be caught. Precondition: harm is attributable on-ledger.
